description: Terminal repair and diagnostic execution envelope for the system_engineer role.
author: Charon System

actions.description: Default execution envelope for the system_engineer role. Accepts escalated DiagnosticArtifact payloads and system constraints, performing root-cause analysis, sandboxed code diff patching, and verification.

user_query.description: Declarative task payload or issue description requiring system engineering intervention.

diagnostic_history.description: Accumulated DiagnosticArtifact records from lower-level agent fast-fail executions.

target_files.description: Explicit file paths identified as targets for inspection or patch application.
